analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for confirmation about which [company_name] hardware and firmware versions support MQTT and cloud services. Conflicting details from different sources create uncertainty when selecting compatible devices for cloud applications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear, trustworthy answers about the compatibility of their specific hardware and firmware versions with MQTT and cloud connectivity.
